items.title: Freeze Claude-only real-host unattended contract
items.context: Document and encode that v1.0.1 only enables policy-bound claude-code real subprocess; Gemini/Codex remain scaffolded/refused, no auto-merge, no productionDone.
items.userSees: 用户运行 lattice help / README 示例时，会看到 dispatch_auto 可在 allowRealHostSubprocess=true policy 下启动 claude-code real runner，但仍显示 manual review / productionDone=false 边界。

happy.desc: Docs and CLI text describe Claude-only real subprocess v1.0.1, explicit policy opt-in, and unchanged authority fields.

edge.desc: Gemini/Codex remain documented as scaffolded or refused, with no wording claiming full real-host fleet support.

adversarial.desc: No doc or command description implies local Claude output can auto-merge, auto-DONE, or verify production receipts.

verificationEvidence.note: Docs and command/process policy text describe Claude Code only, explicit policy opt-in, and authority-safe false fields.
Smoke verifies Gemini/Codex real subprocesses stay refused/scaffolded while Claude Code has the only real runner path.
Existing dispatch smoke preserves manual merge guidance and no productionDone/receiptVerified authority overclaim.

items.title: Add explicit real-host subprocess policy gate
items.context: Dispatch policy must require an explicit opt-in beyond allowedHosts, bind host/scope/commands/env/runtime limits, and keep standalone host_runtime_probe conservative.
items.userSees: 用户创建 claude-code policy 时必须显式传 allowRealHostSubprocess=true；否则 dispatch_auto 会清楚拒绝真实 Claude 启动并解释缺少 opt-in。

happy.desc: A policy with allowedHosts=claude-code plus allowRealHostSubprocess=true is authorized only when all existing receipt/review/budget/network/command constraints are valid.

edge.desc: A claude-code policy without explicit allowRealHostSubprocess stays supervised or refused for real subprocess launch even if allowedHosts includes claude-code.

adversarial.desc: Policy creation/check rejects unsafe env allowlist, auto-merge, productionDone, unknown hosts, out-of-scope paths, and real host subprocess attempts without explicit opt-in.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke creates a claude-code policy with allowRealHostSubprocess=true and verifies it authorizes only under full policy constraints.
Missing policy, unavailable host, unsupported real hosts, and unattendedSafe=false refusal paths remain explicit.
Out-of-policy scope/command and denied env cases refuse before execution or filter secrets.

items.title: Implement Claude Code real runner lifecycle
items.context: Under dispatch_auto with authorized claude-code policy, spawn claude in isolated worktree with bounded env, timeout, stdout/stderr transcript capture, runner metadata, and terminal status mapping.
items.userSees: 用户运行 dispatch_auto 后，dispatch_status/dispatch_watch 显示 runnerKind=claude-code-real、cwd 为 isolated worktree、transcriptPath 和 exitCode/timedOut，而不是 scaffolded/manual-only。

happy.desc: dispatch_auto with an authorized claude-code real-host policy launches a bounded claude subprocess in the isolated dispatch worktree and records runnerKind=claude-code-real with transcript and exit metadata.

edge.desc: A claude subprocess exiting non-zero or timing out records failed status, exitCode/timedOut metadata, transcript output, and no accepted-local receipt.

adversarial.desc: The real Claude runner receives only filtered environment variables and never records secret values in runner metadata or transcript-created summaries.

verificationEvidence.note: Fake claude binary exercises claude --print, isolated cwd, stdout/stderr transcript, runnerKind=claude-code-real, exitCode=0, accepted-local diagnostic receipt.
Non-zero and timeout fake claude cases produce failed status with exitCode/timedOut and no forged receipt.
Env summary records safe LATTICE_ allowlisted names without values and excludes denied/sensitive names.

items.title: Wire watch cancel collect review merge boundaries
items.context: dispatch_watch should expose real runner summary, dispatch_cancel should be able to terminate or mark cancellation safely, collect/review/merge_plan must keep receiptVerified=false and manualOnly=true.
items.userSees: 用户可以用 dispatch_watch/dispatch_review 查看 Claude runner 结果，用 dispatch_cancel 保留证据地停止或标记取消，dispatch_merge_plan 仍只给 manual merge guidance。

happy.desc: dispatch_watch and dispatch_review expose real Claude runner summary, changedFiles, transcript existence, and manual nextAction after a completed real-runner dispatch.

edge.desc: dispatch_cancel on a real-runner record preserves dispatch metadata and reports cancelled/terminal state without deleting transcript or worktree evidence.

adversarial.desc: dispatch_merge_plan remains manualOnly=true and receiptVerified=false/productionDone=false even when the real Claude runner completed successfully.

verificationEvidence.note: dispatch_status/watch/review expose runnerKind, cwd, transcriptPath, exitCode/timedOut, changedFiles, transcriptExists, and localReceiptStatus.
dispatch_cancel preserves pack/prompt/status evidence and dispatch_merge_plan withholds merge guidance for missing/mixed/failed receipts.
All dispatch_auto/watch/review/merge authority fields remain authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, manualOnly=true where applicable.

items.title: Cover deterministic tests plus live canary evidence
items.context: Add fake claude binary smoke coverage for success, timeout, failure, env filtering, scope review, and real-host refusal when policy is absent; run a tiny live Claude canary only after deterministic tests pass.
items.userSees: 最终验证输出会显示 build、dispatch-run smoke、unattended-dispatch smoke 通过；如果 live Claude canary 可用，会额外显示一个只写允许文件的小型真实运行结果。

happy.desc: Deterministic smoke uses a fake claude executable to prove real-runner success without depending on live LLM output.

edge.desc: Deterministic smoke covers timeout, non-zero exit, missing explicit policy opt-in, and scope/command/env policy failures.

adversarial.desc: A live Claude Code canary is either recorded as successful tiny bounded evidence or explicitly classified as unavailable/blocked without weakening deterministic coverage.

verificationEvidence.note: Deterministic fake Claude coverage passed for success/env/nonzero/timeout plus policy/refusal/manual authority paths.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:dispatch-run-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:host-overflow-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:capability-list-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-cli-migration-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Related regression suite passed: dispatch scaffold, host overflow, capability list, and Lattice CLI migration.

verificationEvidence.command: CLI canary in temp git repo using node packages/main/dist/cli.js --root <tmp> dispatch_policy_create/dispatch_auto/dispatch_status/dispatch_watch/dispatch_review/dispatch_merge_plan with fake claude in PATH
verificationEvidence.note: Real CLI entrypoint reached runnerKind=claude-code-real, changedFiles=[packages/main/src/generated/cli-claude.txt], manualOnly=true, authority fields false. The live-provider canary is intentionally classified as deterministic fake-binary evidence to avoid spending user Claude quota during story automation.

auditLog.reason: Starting integration verification for watch/cancel/review/merge surfaces after runner implementation.
Claude-only real-host contract and docs/command policy were implemented and verified.
Explicit real-host subprocess policy gate is implemented and covered.
Claude Code real runner lifecycle is implemented and verified with deterministic fake binary.
Watch/cancel/review/merge boundaries consume runner evidence and stay manual-only.
Deterministic tests and CLI canary verified the completed story.
